title: The 4 Best Milk Frothers for Cold Foam
h1: The 4 Best Milk Frothers for Cold Foam
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for milk frothers for cold foam, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at milk frothers for cold foam using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Nespresso Aeroccino4
products.blurb: Key specs: Dedicated cold froth mode, Non-stick jug rated for cold use, Induction motor with no heating in cold mode.
strengths: Only countertop model in this list with a purpose-built cold froth setting
Produces noticeably denser, longer-lasting foam than whisking cold milk on a general setting
Same jug handles hot froth for other drinks, so it isn't a single-purpose appliance
limitations: No manual control over whisk duration, the cold cycle runs a fixed length
Non-stick coating needs hand washing to avoid scratches over time
features: Non-stick jug rated for cold use
Induction motor with no heating in cold mode

products.name: Zulay Original Milk Frother
products.blurb: Key specs: Handheld battery-powered whisk, Never applies heat, ideal for cold-only use, Works directly in a tall glass or cup.
strengths: Never heats the milk at all, so there's zero risk of accidentally warming a cold foam batch
Full manual control over whisking time to dial in foam density
Works directly in the cup the iced drink is being built in
Cheapest dedicated route to cafe-style cold foam
limitations: Takes more manual effort and time (30 to 45 seconds of active whisking) than a one-button countertop cycle
Foam can be inconsistent between batches depending on whisking technique
Splashes more than a closed jug system if used in a narrow glass
features: Never applies heat, ideal for cold-only use
Works directly in a tall glass or cup
